# U.S. News Travel

> > Comprehensive travel guide and destination rankings for cities and vacation spots across the United States, Canada, Asia, and worldwide.

U.S. News Travel provides expert-curated rankings, interactive maps, neighborhood guides, and vacation planning advice for travelers exploring destinations from Quebec City and Sedona to international locations like Kyoto and Banff. The site features detailed city guides, area maps, and the En Route advice column for trip planning.

## Key Topics

- Destination Rankings
- U.S. Cities
- Canada Travel (Quebec City, Montreal, Banff)
- Asia Destinations (Kyoto, Mount Fuji)
- Vacation Planning
- City Guides
- Area Maps & Neighborhoods
- Arizona Travel (Sedona, Phoenix, Grand Canyon)
- Alaska Cruises
- Royal Caribbean
- Day Trips
- Urban Tourism
- Travel Advice
- Hotel Locations

## Destination Rankings

- [20 Best U.S. Cities to Visit in 2026](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/best-cities-usa/): 2026 rankings of top US cities including NYC and Washington DC
- [Asia Destinations: Rankings](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/asia/): Rankings of best Asia vacation spots including Kyoto and Mount Fuji
- [Canada Destinations: Rankings](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/canada/): Rankings of top Canada destinations including Banff and Quebec City

## Travel Advice & Planning

- [En Route](https://travel.usnews.com/features/en-route?offset=30): Travel advice column with expert tips and vacation planning guidance

## Interactive Area Maps

- [Quebec City Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Quebec_City_Canada/Area_Map/): Interactive map showing Quebec City hotels and attractions locations
- [Sedona Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Sedona_AZ/Area_Map/): Interactive map of Sedona neighborhoods, hotels and Arizona attractions
